The error occurred because R8 code shrinking is enabled for the release build (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), and the default ProGuard/R8 configuration (`proguard-android-optimize.txt`) strips Java generic `Signature` metadata by default. When Gson's `TypeToken` attempts to inspect its own generic superclass (`new TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}`), it fails to find the type argument and throws `IllegalStateException`.

### Fix
Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r1/work/app/proguard-rules.pro) with the necessary ProGuard/R8 rules:
- Preserved generic signatures (`-keepattributes Signature, *Annotation*, EnclosingMethod, InnerClasses`) so reflection on generic types like `TypeToken` succeeds.
- Kept subclasses extending `TypeToken` (`-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }`).
- Kept model classes and fields in `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` so Gson can deserialize JSON keys into model properties without them being stripped or obfuscated.
